lines.trans: Hi, Sasha. How are you doing?
Hi. Everything is fine, and with you?
Everything is fine with me too, running.
Wait, wait at least one second.
What is it? The chef is waiting in the kitchen.
I urgently need to talk to you.
There is one very important personal thing.
You scare me with such a serious look.
I can no longer hide the truth.
I know that you like me.
I am pregnant with your child, Max.
What did you just say right now?
You heard me perfectly the first time.

meanings.en: to run (in one direction), to flee, to escape
meanings.note: irregular mixed conjugation: бегу, бежишь, ..., бегут

examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late!
Where are you running so fast?

meanings.note: usually feminine: беременная, short f: беременна

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: иметь в виду = to mean, to have in mind

examples.text: Из окна красивый вид на парк.
examples.trans: There is a nice view of the park from the window.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: Three rooms and a big kitchen.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
the person who likes is in the dative: мне нравится = I like it
short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job
agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.trans: I know this town really well!
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: с первого раза = the first time

examples.text: Ты не понимаешь с первого раза?
examples.trans: You don't understand the first time?

meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine

examples.text: Первый раз вижу, чтобы людей удочкой пугали.
examples.trans: It's the first time I've seen anyone scare people with a fishing rod.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word
Секунду! = One second! / Just a moment!

examples.trans: One second. I'll call right now.

examples.text: Я приехала к очень серьёзному человеку.
examples.trans: I have come to see a very important man.

meanings.note: to keep from sight or knowledge

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent

examples.trans: I need to make a phone call urgently.

meanings.note: the infinitive 'Стоять!' as a police order

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: irregular plural уши, genitive plural ушей

examples.trans: I'm going to cut off your ear right now!

хотя.gloss: even if, at least (with бы); although

meanings.note: нужно хотя бы поговорить = we need at least to talk

examples.text: Нужно хотя бы поговорить с ними.
examples.trans: We need at least to talk with them.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
